concepts.quote: If you compile after every few lines, each error is next to the code you just wrote, so it is easy to find.
concepts.why: The answer says to compile often during small changes so that each error is found close to its cause, which is the L4 transfer way.

concepts.quote: each error is next to the code you just wrote, so it is easy to find

The answer says nothing about reading or interpreting error messages.
